en: The Vinaya-piṭaka Treatises:
The *Daśādhyāya-vinaya* (Ten-Section Vinaya) in ten fascicles, translated by Zhu Fonian during the Fu Qin period,
recorded and presented to the Emperor by the Great Dharma Master Rongwen of Yakushi-ji of the Lü school.
The *Dharmaguptaka-vinaya* in sixty fascicles, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Buddhayaśas together with Zhu Fonian;
the *Mahīśāsaka-vinaya* in thirty fascicles, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Buddhabhadra together with Zhu Daosheng and others;

the *Mahīśāsaka-bhikṣuṇī-prātimokṣa-sūtra* in one fascicle, compiled by Minghui of the Liang dynasty; and the *Sarvāstivāda-prātimokṣa-sūtra* in one fascicle, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Kumārajīva.
The *Daśabhāṇavāra-vinaya* (Ten Recitations Vinaya) in sixty-one fascicles: the first fifty-eight fascicles were translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Puṇyatāra and others during the Yao Qin dynasty;
the final three fascicles, the *Vinayottaragrantha*, were continued and translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Vimalākṣa during the Eastern Jin dynasty.
The *Mahāsāṃghika-vinaya* in forty fascicles was translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Buddhabhadra together with Faxian. The *Mahāsāṃghika-...* [text truncated]
*Śīla-mūla-sūtra*, one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Buddhabhadra. *Vibhāṣā-vinaya*, one fascicle.
*Mūlasarvāstivāda-vinaya-saṃgraha*, twenty fascicles. *Mūlasarvāstivāda-bhikṣuṇī-vinaya*, twenty fascicles.
*Mūlasarvāstivāda-vinaya*, fifty fascicles. *Mūlasarvāstivāda-vinaya* [continued], five fascicles.
The *Sarvāstivāda-vinaya-kṣudraka-vastu* in forty fascicles;
the *Mūlasarvāstivāda-nidāna-mātṛkā* in ten fascicles; the *Mūlasarvāstivāda-vinaya-gāthā* in five fascicles;
and the *Mūlasarvāstivāda-vinaya-kṣudraka-vastu-saṃgraha-gāthā* in one fascicle. The *Mūlasarvāstivāda*.
One fascicle of the *Sarvāstivāda-vinaya-nidāna-mātṛkā-saṃgraha-gāthā*;
ten fascicles of the *Mūlasarvāstivāda-ekottara-karman*—the above nine works were all translated by Tripiṭaka Master Yijing;

one fascicle of the *Śrāmaṇera-daśa-śīla-dharma-sahitavinyāsa* (The Ten Precepts for Śrāmaṇeras with Their Rituals), translator’s name lost; one fascicle of the *Śrāmaṇera-vinyāsa* (Rituals for Śrāmaṇeras).
*The Miscellaneous Precepts for Śrāmaṇerikās*, one fascicle, translated by Tripiṭaka Guṇavarman; translator’s name lost. *The Upāsaka Precepts*, one fascicle.
*The One Hundred and One Karmavācanās of the Great Śramaṇa*, one fascicle. *The Dharmaguptaka Karmavācanā*, one fascicle, listed in Sengyou’s Catalogue;
translator’s name lost. *The Miscellaneous Karmavācanās of the Four-Part Vinaya*, translated by the śramaṇa Tandi.
*The Karmavācanā for Bhikṣuṇīs of the Dharmaguptaka School*, one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Saṃghavarman of Kang.

*The Karmavācanā for Bhikṣus of the Dharmaguptaka School*, one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Guṇavarman. *The Revised and Supplemented Karmavācanā according to Circumstances of the Dharmaguptaka School*, one fascicle;
compiled by Daoxuan of Zhongnan Mountain. *The Karmavācanā for Bhikṣuṇīs of the Dharmaguptaka School*, three fascicles; compiled by Huaisu.

*Jí wǔfēn jiémó* (Collection of the Five-Part *Karmavācanā*), one fascicle; compiled by Àitóng of Dàkāiyè Monastery. *Shísòng jiémó bǐqiū yāoyòng* (Essential Use of the *Karmavācanā* for Bhikṣus according to the *Daśabhāṇavāra-vinaya*), one fascicle;
compiled by Sēngqú of Zhōngxīng Monastery. *Sìfèn jìběn chāo* (Commentary on the *Sifen Vinaya Precept Manual*), three fascicles;

*Sanjuàn chāo* (Three-Fascicle Commentary), one fascicle; *Liujuàn chāo* (Six-Fascicle Commentary), six fascicles; *Sìfèn lǜ shū* (Commentary on the *Sifen Vinaya*), ten fascicles; narrated by Dàxuān; *Sìfèn lǜ shū* (Commentary on the *Sifen Vinaya*), four fascicles; narrated by Huáisù.
*Fen jieben shu* (Commentary on the *Prātimokṣa-sūtra*), three fascicles; authored by Dingbin. *Sifenlü shu* (Commentary on the *Dharmaguptaka-vinaya*), ten fascicles;

authored by Fali. *Jiemoshu* (Commentary on the *Karmavācanā*), three fascicles. *Liaojian* (Excerpts and Selections), six fascicles; authored by Daoxuan. *Chaoji* (Record of Excerpts), ten fascicles;
authored by Zhiren of Silla. *Chaoji*, one fascicle; authored by Yü of Andong, who states that Xuanjing embellished the school.

*Yiji* (Record of Meanings), ten fascicles; *Kaizongji* (Record on the Opening of the Sect), ten fascicles, both composed by Dingbin; *Fazhengji* (Record on Elucidating the Correct Meaning), ten fascicles; *Abiduan Yiji* (Record of Meanings on the Abhidharma), one fascicle;

*Sifenlü Qingzhongyi* (Ritual for the Gravity and Lightness of the Four-Part Vinaya), one fascicle, composed by Daoxuan; *Sifenlü Qingzhongji* (Record on the Gravity and Lightness of the Four-Part Vinaya), three fascicles;
*Sifenlü Shuchaoji* (Record of the Commentary and Sub-commentary on the Four-Part Vinaya), ten fascicles, composed by Juequan; and various sutras.
*Yaoji* (Essential Compendium), twenty fascicles, composed by Daoxuan; *Shami Shami Ni Wei Jin* (The Novice Monks and Novice Nuns Who Have Not Yet Advanced), one fascicle;

*Sifenlü Chao Pi* (Annotations on the Commentary to the Dharmaguptaka Vinaya), fourteen fascicles, composed by Dajue of Huayan Monastery; *Biqiuni Zhuan* (Biographies of Bhikṣuṇīs), four fascicles, composed by Baochang of Zhuangyan Monastery;

*Datang Nanhai Jiguinei Fa Zhuan* (Record of the Inner Dharma Sent Back from the Southern Seas during the Great Tang), four fascicles, composed by Tripiṭaka Master Yijing; *Puxian*... [text fragment].
*Śīla-karman of the Bodhisattva Precepts*, one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Xuanzang. *Commentary on the Brahma Net Sūtra*, two fascicles; composed by Dharma Master Ji.
*Commentary on the Brahma Net Sūtra*, two fascicles; composed by Wonhyo. *Commentary on the Brahma Net Sūtra*, five fascicles; composed by Zhizhou.

*Commentary on the Brahma Net Sūtra*, three fascicles; composed by Fazang. *Record of the Antiquities of the Brahma Net Sūtra*, two fascicles; composed by Tae-hyeon of Qingqiu. *Exegesis of the Brahma Net Text*, [fascicles].

The *Lingxi Taizi Pusa jie shu* (Commentary on the Bodhisattva Precepts by Prince Lingxi) in two fascicles is this very work; the *Fanwang chifan yaolu ji* (Record of Essential Points on Observance and Transgression of the Brahmajāla Sūtra) in one fascicle was composed by Wonhyo;
and the *Fanwang sicaochao* (Private Commentary on the Brahmajāla Sūtra) in two fascicles.
